title: The Inventory of Small Wins
skyStory: The waning crescent is down to a fingernail clipping of light in Aquarius, seven percent and fading. The moon is doing its end-of-cycle bookkeeping, counting every little victory from the past month on an abacus made of stars. Saturn checks the math twice. Mars just wants to know if any of the wins were loud. The answer is no, and that is exactly the point.

reading: The cabin is doing inventory tonight: kindling stacked, kettle filled, boots by the door. You need the same pause. You have finished more this past month than you give yourself credit for, and the list is hiding because you never stop long enough to read it.

Before dinner, write down five things you did since February. Small counts. Fixed a hinge counts. Answered a hard message counts. Made someone laugh in a dull meeting definitely counts. The [[Nine of Cups]] in its shadow form whispers that wishes feel hollow when you never notice them coming true. Notice them. Read the list back once, slowly, like it belongs to someone you admire.
joel.mission: Write five small wins from the past month on a sticky note and put it where you will see it tomorrow morning.
joel.omen: A neatly stacked pile of anything, like plates, wood or books. It means your foundations are stronger than they feel.

reading: The Wood Rat is a famous collector, and today you are collecting proof. Proof that the steady, patient work has been working. It has. Someone you helped level up recently is about to tell you so, maybe sideways, maybe as a joke, but it counts.

Your diamond catches the light from a computer screen at 3:20 pm and you will remember, suddenly, something good you said to someone weeks ago. It landed. It mattered. The heart element wants you to sit with that for a full sixty seconds without rushing to the next task. Sixty seconds. Count them on your fingers if you have to. Your hands love a job.
nancy.mission: Spend sixty uninterrupted seconds remembering one person you helped this winter, then send them a short hello with no reason given.
nancy.omen: A paper clip, ribbon or thread found on the floor. Some untidy little matter is about to wrap itself up with a bow.
nancy.elementWhy: feel the wins, not just list

together.text: Trade lists. Each of you send the other your three proudest small wins of the past month. The other person must respond with one word only, something huge, like magnificent or legendary or historic. Both lists get stored in the cabin's imaginary trophy case.
